description_en: Queries the databases and tables whose data is included in a cross-region backup file of an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS实例跨地域备份的库表信息
name: DescribeCrossBackupMetaList

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cross-region backup file that you want to use. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/121733.html operation to query the ID of the cross-region backup file
parameters.help_zh: 跨地域备份集ID。可以通过接口DescribeCrossRegionBackups查询
parameters.name: backup_set_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the database that you want to query. The system implements exact match based on the value of this parameter and returns the name of the matched database and the names of the tables in the matched database
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的数据库名。精确匹配，会返回具体的数据库名以及库内的表名
parameters.name: get_db_name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database that you want to query. The system implements fuzzy match based on the value of this parameter and returns only the name of the matched database.

You can implement fuzzy match and then exact match. For example, you can set the Pattern parameter to test to query the testdb1 and testdb2 databases. Then, you can specify the GetDbName parameter to query only the matched database and the tables in the matched database
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的数据库名。模糊匹配，只返回匹配的数据库名，不返回表名。
您可以先模糊匹配，例如传入test匹配testdb1和testdb2，确定目标数据库名称后再精确匹配，通过传入GetDbName查看具体的数据库名和表名
parameters.name: pattern

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return per page. Default value: 1.

This parameter only takes effect when you specify the PageIndex parameter
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数。默认值：1。
需要和PageIndex一起传入才生效
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The number of the page to return. Valid values: any non-zero positive integer.

This parameter only takes effect when you specify the PageSize parameter
parameters.help_zh:
页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。
需要和PageSize一起传入才生效
parameters.name: page_index

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

DBInstanceName.description_en: The instance to which the cross-region backup file belongs
DBInstanceName.description_zh: 跨地域备份集所属实例

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of entries returned per page

TotalPageCount.description_en: The total number of pages returned

TotalRecordCount.description_en: The total number of returned entries
